name: Tommy Hilfiger
description: Tommy Hilfiger is one of the world’s leading designer lifestyle brands and is internationally recognized for celebrating the essence of classic American cool style, featuring preppy with a twist designs.

name: Napapijri
description: Founded in Italy in 1987, Napapijri celebrates the unexpected journey and outfits adventures that leave a mark. Representing a global mindset through the intersection of boundaries, culture, nature and art, the brand portfolio includes Menswear, Womenswear and Childrenswear. It draws inspiration from the wondrous in nature and enables the self-expression of individuals that see the world with a thoughtful mind and an artful touch.

name: Vivienne Westwood
description: With a design record spanning more than 40 years, Vivienne Westwood is one of the last independent global fashion companies in the world.

name: Luxury Zone
description: Luxury Zone has revolutionised the jewellery shop concept: it is a unique, stylish, refined and elegant space, where you will find the luxury you have always desired thanks to professional, specialist staff who are always there to assist you.

name: Fratelli Rossetti
description: The Fratelli Rossetti factory was founded in 1953 by visionary Renzo Rossetti in Parabiago. The company is currently run by the second hands-on generation of the family. A story that allowed the brand to distinguish itself as a synonym of the utmost style, both in Italy and abroad: an enduring milestone of timeless craftsmanship.

name: Timberland
description: The company has expanded into clothing and accessories, and found fans in David Duchovny, Mark Wahlberg and hip hop star Timbaland, who took his nickname from his penchant for the boots.

name: Peuterey
description: Founded in 2002, Peuterey is the flagship brand of the Peuterey Group. Design, innovation, and quality are the hallmarks of a company which stands out for its elegant, yet relaxed style represented by contemporary “luxury casualwear” products.

name: Lagostina - Home & Cook
description: Launched less than a decade ago, Lagostina - Home & Cook is already represented in 12 European countries, selling Tefal, Rowenta, Moulinex, Krups and Lagostina appliances.

name: Visionottica
description: VisionOttica offers a wide selection of prescription glasses and sunglasses from the best brands: Dolce & Gabbana, Gucci, Liu Jo, Love Moschino, Marc Jacobs, Oakley, Persol, Polaroid, Ray-Ban, Tommy Hilfiger, Vogue.

name: Gutteridge
description: In 1875, Michael Gutteridge and his wife landed in Naples from Scotland to settle in a warmer climate. In April 1878, the first Gutteridge store opened in Piazza Dante and began a flourishing trade in cotton textiles and wool imported from Scotland. Today, the Italian menswear brand produces a full range of quality clothing and accessories.

name: Baldinini
description: Fabulously desirable footwear for men and women from a brand which originated as a family-run made-to-measure shoe workshop on Italy's Adriatic Coast in 1910; the making by hand tradition has stayed with the company and is today combined with cutting-edge design to create ‘dreams you can wear’.

name: Missoni
description:
Missoni is one of the leading fashion houses and amongst the most recognized the world over.
The Missoni style is the result of a long collaboration between Ottavio Missoni and his wife Rosita. After marrying in 1953, they began making knitwear pieces in a small lab in the basement of their home in Gallarate. The path undertaken by Ottavio and Rosita has been carried on by their children and grandchildren, who continue to keep the Missoni style alive in the world. In 1997, Rosita passed her leadership role as creative director to Angela, dedicating herself to the Missoni Home line, for which she is currently the Creative Director. Angela Missoni is the Creative Director of the business and is committed to infusing the family brand with new energy, communicating new trends and ideas. Luca Missoni is the Artistic Director of the Missoni Archives and is currently developing a project aimed at promoting and showing off the artistic heritage of the brand.

name: Caleffi
description: Based in Viadana, Italy, Caleffi brings a touch of luxury to everyday home accessories using premium fabrics such as cotton percale, Jacquard satin and high quality terry. Offering fabrics for the living room, the bathroom, the bedroom and the kitchen, this purveyor of the finest textiles will please the most discerning of luxury textile lovers. Junior textile junkies will adore the Disney range.

name: Salomon
description: Salomon promotes the progress of mountain sports through the development of innovative technical products, with particular attention to the environment and nature.

name: NIKE
description: Nike Factory Stores offer Nike performance products at exceptional value. At Nike Factory Stores, consumers experience a premium shopping environment that serves athletes of all ages.

name: Elena Mirò
description: Elena Mirò is the refined brand with Italian styling that, with more than 30 years of experience, succeeds in expressing the quintessence of femininity.

name: P.A.R.O.S.H.
description: With a passion for originality and detail, P.A.R.O.S.H creates beautiful vintage dresses with a unique twist. The contemporary designs balance timeless tailoring with ethnic tones and luxe textures, creating an aesthetic that has driven Paolo Rossello's brand to success over the years.

name: Versace
description: Under the artistic direction of Donatella Versace since 1997, Versace designs, manufactures, distributes and retails fashion and lifestyle products including haute couture, women's and men's ready-to-wear, jewellery, watches, accessories, fragrances and furniture.

name: L'Occitane
description: L'Occitane en Provence is a French company that was founded in 1976 and offers beauty products for the body and face, as well as high-quality fragrances inspired by the Mediterranean ‘art de vivre’ and created according to the principles of phytotherapy and aromatherapy.

name: Venchi
description: Carefully creating the finest chocolates since 1978, Venchi takes traditional Italian ingredients and prides itself on a natural approach to gourmet sweets. Over the years, innovation and experimentation have led to new flavour combinations, free from the use of artificial colours, preservatives and additives.

name: Welcome Centre - The Concierge
description: Welcome Centre - The Concierge

name: Lacoste
description: Since the creation of the first polo shirt in 1933, Lacoste has built on its authentic sporting heritage to bring optimism and elegance to the world through a unique and original lifestyle for women, men and children.

name: Malìparmi
description: Bags, along with jewelry, have been the springboard of this great adventure characterized by nomadic spirit, grown up to the creation of the total look for contemporary women.

name: Mandarina Duck
description: Mandarina Duck is an innovative brand that offers creative and original solutions with a contemporary and informal style. Curious, positive and always in motion, Mandarina Duck offers unrivalled solutions that combine intelligent design and unconventional materials, together with an original use of colours and strong attention to detail.

name: Luisa Spagnoli
description: Luisa Spagnoli is a leading Italian womenswear brand, founded in 1928, which is named after its brilliant designer.

name: Armani
description: In 1975 Giorgio Armani founded his company in Milan. His style is synonymous with luxury and contemporary elegance, modernity, and sophistication, as expressed also in his interior design and home accessory brand Armani Home.

name: K-Way
description: K-WAY was founded in Paris in 1965, when, during a rainy winter day, the first windproof and waterproof jacket was created. Since then, the brand has developed its own unique style with a focus on form, style and function. Discover the collections today.

name: Liu Jo Uomo
description: Liu Jo Man is the menswear brand of the Italian company Liu Jo. The Liu Jo collection for men includes a wide range of clothing, which combines sophisticated and urban comfort with elegance. Style, simplicity and high-quality materials are the essential elements that identify Liu Jo Man.

name: Etro
description: Italian fashion house Etro was founded in 1968 by Gerolamo ‘Gimmo’ Etro, a traveller educated in economics, who formed his own textile company creating beautiful fabrics. The Milan-based brand is still a family business today, offering ready-to-wear, footwear, jewellery, accessories, leather goods, fragrances and homeware, inspired by the brand’s rich archive of rare books and textiles.

name: Diesel
description: Diesel is never just a pair of jeans. It’s a statement on individuality and self-expression, a battle cry for innovation, artistry and technical expertise, and a belief that passion is the greatest muse. Founder Renzo Rosso has drawn from this over the past 35 years to create a lifestyle brand that’s as much rooted in denim as it is in his vision for the future. This is Diesel.

name: Parma Menù - Famiglia Carpanese
description: In our bar and restaurant you are not just guests, but friends with whom we want to share the love of good food – simple and genuine flavours. For more than 50 years, we have begun the day kneading dough – the heart of Parma cuisine. Pop in in the morning, maybe for a tasty breakfast or an artisan coffee, and you'll see our rezdore busy baking cakes and making fried dumplings, because here everything is homemade following our family's recipes. This is Parma, with fresh pasta and all kinds of meats made from the best craftsmen, perfect for a sandwich or a platter accompanied by fried dumplings. Top it off with the sweetest Parmigiano Reggiano, maybe accompanied by a fresh and lively Lambrusco.

name: Levi's
description: The founder of Levi’s originally set out to make his fortune in the California Gold Rush of the mid-nineteenth century. Levi Strauss moved from New York to San Francisco and established a wholesale dry goods business. One day he received a letter from a customer, a tailor who used metal rivets to make trousers stronger for the labouring men who bought them. The two men were granted a patent on May 20, 1873 and the blue jean was born.

name: Piquadro
description: Formed in Bologna in 1987 by 23-year-old Marco Palmieri, Piquadro travel and business luggage is characterised by a blend of traditional Italian craftsmanship, innovation and technology.

name: Trussardi
description: For more than 100 years, the Trussardi brand has stated the commitment of a family to spread contemporary Italian style all over the world.

name: Samsonite
description: Sold in more than 100 countries, Samsonite is the world’s number one luggage maker and has built a business on bags able to withstand the trials of international travel.

name: Liu Jo
description: Liu Jo’s creative philosophy focuses on enhancing the femininity and natural beauty of every woman, which is expressed with a refined, glamorous style that is always open to personal interpretation, with the brand offering a total look, from dresses to shoes and accessories.

name: Furla
description: Furla is a premium accessories brand whose style codes are defined by an upbeat and inspiring Italian lifestyle. A fusion of contemporary design, top quality craftsmanship and an upbeat edge that make the difference.

name: Dolce & Gabbana
description: Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana started their fashion empire in the early 1980s and soon made a splash with outré styling and bold, geometric shapes. Their trademark corsetry has won over many a music star and celebrity, including Madonna, for whose Girlie Tour the Italian duo designed more then 1,500 costumes.

name: Jimmy Choo
description: Founded in London in 1996, Jimmy Choo is an iconic luxury fashion brand defined by an empowered sense of glamour and a confident sense of style.

name: Marni
description: Innovative and multifaceted, Marni is recognized all over the world for its luxury ready-to-wear and accessories collections Made in Italy.

name: Paul Smith
description: With an enthusiasm for eclectic cultural references and idiosyncratic combinations of pattern and colour, applied with understatement, Paul Smith expresses a truly contemporary aesthetic.

name: Coach
description: Coach is a modern American luxury brand with a rich heritage rooted in quality and craftsmanship. All over the world, the Coach name is synonymous with the ease and sophistication of New York style.

name: Michael Kors
description: With an innate sense of glamour, Michael Kors offers a luxury lifestyle for the consummate jet setter that is as sophisticated as it is indulgent and as iconic as it is modern.

name: Ixos
description: Beautiful ready-to-wear fashion for women, with an emphasis on luxurious, flowing fabrics and natural hues, conceived and created by Fabio Malloni of the shoe-making dynasty and his wife Floriana Orsetto.

name: Zwilling
description: Since 1731, Zwilling has been a brand of the highest quality, without compromise.

name: Pinko
description: PINKO is an Italian independent fashion brand which, through its creativity and its natural tension to beauty, offers collections with an eye toward future.

name: Angelico
description: Lanificio Angelico was founded in 1956, at the heart of the Italian textile industry, and within a few years it had become one of the most important producers of high-quality fabrics, producing stylish clothing collections on an annual basis.

name: New Balance
description: New Balance began as a Boston-based arch support company in the early 1900's, developed into a specialized shoe manufacturer in the 1970's, and has grown to become a leading global athletic products company. Today New Balance is a family of brands including New Balance, Dunham, PF Flyers, Aravon, Warrior and Brine.

name: North Sails
description: Today Lowell North’s inspiration lives on in North Sails apparel as well, as it is designed and developed so that our customers can focus on what’s important for them – taking on the sea or just navigating modern life.

name: Braccialini
description: The theft of Carla Braccialini’s handbag inspired her to create a bag in the shape of a house with the legend “In your handbag lies all your life”. The bag was a hit and gave Carla the opportunity to go to town with her creativity and passion, resulting in the whimsical shapes of the Temi range, the playful Tua range and the bold designs of I Temini, each bag an individual masterpiece in Italian leather-working.

name: Frette
description: Possibly the world's best-known name in luxury linens, Frette offers Egyptian cotton bedding, Mongolian cashmere blankets and sumptuous velvet cushions.

name: Roy Roger’s
description: Roy Roger's is an Italian fashion brand part of Sevenbell group, manufactured by the florentine Manifatture 7 Bell s.p.a., pioneer in blue jeans production since 1952. The name of Roy Roger's has always been associated with denim, and their original models introduced features that never changed over the years, becoming the brand's recognisable trademarks: zippers on back pockets, to keep the pocket money safe at work, a coin pocket on the front, and the brand "logo", characterised by the black triangular label on the right back pocket. Roy Roger's evolution during the years includes the proposal of a men's, women's and children's total look, with different lines and labels, taking from the brand's historical archive and blending it with contemporary trends. All the collections are proudly made in Italy and can be found internationally at selected retailers, online and in Italy in its flagship stores in Florence, Forte dei Marmi and Milan.

name: Ferrari Store
description: The Ferrari Store allows all fans to be a part of the Maranello brand, offering a range of products for men, women and children, with classic and elegant clothing, sporty and chic accessories and toys for children of all ages.

name: Guess
description: Sexy, adventurous, trend-setting apparel and accessories for men and women from the American brand started by four entrepreneurial Moroccan brothers in 1981.

name: Polo Ralph Lauren
description: Discover a world of timeless apparel at Ralph Lauren. Ralph Lauren’s uniquely American approach to style blends heritage pieces that are equal parts classic and modern.

name: Boggi Milano
description: Since 1939, Boggi Milano is an expression of Italian excellence aimed at a contemporary and cosmopolitan man

name: Twinset
description: Beautifully crafted collections with feminine, seductive and easy-to-wear style, featuring distinctive colors, prints and textures. Twinset provides its Lovers looks that can effortlessly take them from office hours to after-hours.

name: Lindt
description: Lindt’s luxury Swiss chocolates have their origins in a small pastry shop in Zurich's old town. In 1845, the owners decided to adopt the new Italian fashion of serving chocolate in solid bars rather than the traditional drink. Later they bought the famous brand of Rodolphe Lindt, along with his secrets to unlocking the chocolate’s melting qualities. Today these innovations live on in Lindor, a signature confection characterised by a hard shell and a smooth chocolate filling.

name: Vilebrequin
description: A sharp-eyed observer of the privileged bathers on the French Riviera beach fashioned the first ever boxer short swimming trunks from the chequered cloth on his café table. When the inventor hit upon a quick-drying spinnaker canvas, the car enthusiast named the results of his innovation Vilebrequin, meaning “crankshaft”. His upmarket swimwear won the loyalty of the St Tropez set and can now be found on every exclusive beachside in the world.

name: Swarovski
description: Swarovski, the world’s leading producer of precision-cut crystal and synonymous of light and elegance shows in our Boutique the sparkling collections of jewelry, watches, accessories and decorative objects.

name: Coccinelle
description: Much-coveted leather goods label based in Parma, Italy: to-die-for bags, footwear, purses, jewellery and scarves.

name: Calvin Klein
description:
Visit the new Calvin Klein boutique and discover the Calvin Klein Jeans and Calvin Klein Underwear collections
Calvin Klein young and sexy brand, an expression of American and casual style, offers a complete collection of denim, in different fits and washes, embellished with unique details and innovative treatments. Each season the brand offers iconic style garments, inspired by American culture, without neglecting new and eye-catching styles.

name: Dsquared2
description: The intelligent mix of irreverent Canadian wit and refined Italian tailoring combined with an attention for details are the foundation of Dsquared2 philosophy that has given life to a unique concept of alternative luxury.

name: Zegna
description: Menswear brand Ermenegildo Zegna is one of Italy’s most famous family businesses. The story began when Ermenegildo Zegna founded the Lanificio Zegna wool mill in 1910.

name: The Bridge
description: Florence-born brand The Bridge has a long history of exquisite craftsmanship, creating bags and accessories from the finest materials. All proudly Made in Italy, the natural and timeless elegance of each leather piece is unmistakable.

name: Alviero Martini 1A Classe
description: Taking inspiration from legendary voyages and exploration, Alviero Martini 1a Classe is best known for premium handcrafted leather goods and bags featuring ancient maps, antique lettering and symbols. Alongside leather goods, the label has a collection of mens, womens and childrenswear.

name: The Cosmetics Company Store
description: The Cosmetics Company Store is the one-stop boutique for world-renowned beauty brands. Discover beauty and grooming products for women and men, including make-up, skincare, haircare, brushes and fragrances from favourite brands.

name: Pollini
description: Pollini was founded in 1953 in San Mauro Pascoli, a small town in Emilia Romagna. In time, the area became an authentic shoemaking district thanks to the local highly skilled artisans. Pollini’s brand continued to grow throughout the years and, in 2001, the brand became part of the prestigious luxury group, Aeffe.

name: Paul & Shark
description: Paul & Shark combines innovation and high tech performance with Italian heritage and expertise to create a lifestyle collection for menswear, womenswear and childrenswear.

name: Blumarine
description: Founded by Anna Molinari in 1977, Blumarine is a luxury Italian brand known for its sexy, feminine clothing. Inspired by flowers, travel, painting and music, Blumarine represents Molinari's affinity for both modern objects and antiques

name: Elisabetta Franchi
description: Proud of its Made-in-Italy heritage, the Elisabetta Franchi clothing line was created to dress the modern woman. Inspired by the versatility of the ‘little black dress’, the collections are feminine and timeless. The Passepartout capsule collection is designed, as the name suggests, to take the wearer from day to evening, from a coffee date to a launch, allowing her to be sexy, chic and metropolitan all in one stroke.

name: Prada
description: Producing luxury lifestyle products since 1913, Prada prides itself on uncompromised quality and design innovation.

name: Loro Piana
description:
Loro Piana is committed to quality, high-performance textile innovation and imbuing each of its designs with timeless Italian elegance.
Loro Piana is committed to quality, high-performance textile innovation and imbuing each of its designs with timeless Italian elegance.

name: Aspesi
description:
Since its founding by Alberto Aspesi in 1969, the Aspesi brand has been defined by its unwavering pursuit of basic, timeless classics. 
Unconventional and purposefully under-promoted, Aspesi has nonetheless captured a dedicated following of discerning customers who respond to superb quality and distinction.

name: Gallo
description: Looking to the foot to express the heart is the choice of Italian hosiery brand Gallo. Famed for its artisanal culture, superior fabrics and proud tradition of passing skills from father to son, the company has earned a reputation for marrying classic styles with strikingly modern in-house designs.

name: Under Armour
description: Under Armour's mission is to make all athletes better through passion, design, and the relentless pursuit of innovation. Every Under Armour product is doing something for you; it's making you better.

name: Ugo Colella
description: Neapolitan tailoring, classic, elegant lines, hand-stitched detailing and a passion for perfection define this sporty, casual, men's fashion brand.

name: Fabiana Filippi
description: The history of Fabiana Filippi is strongly rooted in the passion and pragmatism of its founders. This story of Italian entrepreneurship began in 1985 in the heart of Umbria, conventionally embodying the authentically “Made in Italy”, characterized by high quality, competence and skill in craftwork.

name: Koi Sushi
description:
Discover Koi Sushi’s new location, complete with an outdoor terrace and a refreshed menu, the new restaurant is set to give you a truly exclusive experience!

Enjoy new additions to the menu, including tacos, millefeuille and sashimi. Plus, you can now enjoy Koi Sushi at home, with the restaurant's fabulous products available to purchase inside. Inside the restaurant,

The full menu will be available soon, so keep an eye out for more details. If you love sushi, then you'll love Koi Sushi!

name: Sunglass Hut
description:
NEW OPENING

At Sunglass Hut, our mission is to be the premier shopping and inspiration destination for the top brands, latest trends and exclusive styles of high quality fashion and performance sunglasses.

The Sunglass Hut boutique offers items by a selection of brands, including:

Ray-Ban

Oakley

Vogue

Persol

Arnette

Ray-Ban Junior

Bulgari

Burberry

Dolce & Gabbana

Emporio Armani

Prada 

Valentino

Versace

name: Borbonese
description: Borbonese is a historic Italian fashion house renowned for its craftsmanship, its sophisticated production techniques and the use of precious materials. Founded in Turin in 1910, it is one of the oldest fashion houses in Italy, specializing in accessories and in prêt-à-porter and recognized for the iconic print "Partridge Eye”, also called OP.

name: Karl Lagerfeld
description: The house of KARL LAGERFELD shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its founder, Karl Lagerfeld, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit. The brand celebrates his colossal legacy and breathes his passion and inexhaustible creativity.

name: Eleventy
description: At Eleventy Milano, we believe in the concept of a world where people aspire to become the best version of themselves through daily gestures and interactions with other people and with the environment that surrounds them.

name: Ermanno Scervino
description: In 2000, from the union of Ermanno's creativity and Toni Scervino's entrepreneurship, Maison Ermanno Scervino was born in Florence and has become synonymous with quality, Made in Italy and international style. A product that combines excellent craftsmanship with innovation: lace, knitwear, dresses and outerwear are the focus of the brand's collections.

name: Signorvino
description: Signorvino is a point of reference for all food and wine enthusiasts and for all those who have the curiosity to discover this magical world with ease, having fun and experiencing the best of Italian production at affordable prices.

name: Rene Caovilla
description: The Caovilla Maison was born in 1932 in Fiesso D’Artico, a few kilometers from Venice. It is here, in the heart of the footwear tradition, that Edoardo Caovilla opens his workshop.

name: adidas
description: The adidas boutique in Fidenza Village is the place where lovers of sports as well as fashion can find everything they need.

name: MooRER
description:
The perfect synthesis of tradition and innovation
MooRER’s ready-to-wear and outerwear collections for men and women combine impeccable tailoring with refined, natural materials. Elegance, style and attention to detail are combined in its tailor-made, handcrafted designs.

Each element of the items’ creation, from the exclusive fabrics to sophisticated designs, is certified 100% made in Italy. The collections are a tribute to excellence and the alchemical balance of luxury.

MooRER believes that the coexistence of form and function is essential, and that a garment can be both comfortable and technically advanced while remaining faithful to its vision of luxury and exclusivity.

name: Pinalli
description:
An empire of beauty offering more than 30 years of exceptional expertise
Founded in Emilia, Italy, Pinalli is renowned for its excellence in service, advice and quality.

name: Stella McCartney
description: Stella McCartney is a luxury lifestyle brand that was launched under the designer’s name in 2001.

name: Peserico
description: Peserico represents the passion for great sartorial and manufacturing tradition of the Veneto region.

name: The North Face
description: The North Face® è stato fondato nel 1966 con l’obiettivo di preparare gli atleti dell’outdoor alle inclemenze delle loro future avventure

name: Rituals
description: Rituals is a universe of beauty and wellness for personal and home care. It is the first brand in the world to combine cosmetics and lifestyle with the aim of transforming daily routines into meaningful moments.

name: Jacob Cohën
description:
Handmade tailored luxury jeans for men and women
Beginning with the timeless five pockets and truckers, Jacob Cohën’s aesthetic is shaped by great attention to details, the finest fabrics and accessories such as jewel buttons, iconic patches and tailored finishes, carefully made in our workshops. The research of the highest quality raw materials, including the best selvedge fabrics and the most exclusive Japanese denim, is still the propulsive soul of the brand, which has applied its luxury attitude to the creation of a contemporary total look for men and women.

name: BOSS
description: BOSS offers sophisticated, modern collections focused on quality and design to create an impeccable look.

name: HUGO
description:
HUGO is designed for those who take their own approach to style.
HUGO collection is created for rule-breakers, rebels, visionaries. Those who go their own way and don’t look back. HUGO isn’t just about clothes: it’s a state of mind.

name: Valentino Garavani
description: Valentino is synonymous of inclusiveness, uniqueness and creativity.

name: Hogan Fay
description: Sophisticated accessories and clothing, with an essential, innovative design and the perfect combination of function and informal elegance, made in top-quality materials.

name: Kids around
description:
Kids around is a store dedicated to famous brands from kids designers:

BOSS Kidswear, KENZO KIDS, KARL LAGERFELD Kids, Givenchy, Chloé, Michael Kors, HUGO Kids, Marc Jacobs and DKNY.

Boys and Girls collections, from 0 to 16 years.

Find Childrenswear, accessoires and newborn at discounted prices all year long.

Fashion is also for the kids!

name: NOVE25
description: Nove25 is a brand of Urban Jewelry established in 2005, which creates jewelry by translating ideas and personality into material, thanks to the master goldsmiths and designers of the Milanese Creative Laboratory who infuse experience into

name: Panino Giusto
description:
Panino Giusto is bringing its celebrated sandwiches and salads to Fidenza Village
Established in Milan in 1979, Panino Giusto first launched as an ambitious project to reimagine the beloved Italian sandwich; one that expressed the quality and excellence of the country’s culinary skills whilst meeting the city’s energetic demand for fast but quality dining. With a commitment to Italian produce, masterful ingredient pairings and respect for seasonal produce, the adored sandwich eatery soon became recognised as “the Italian Art of the Panino,” drawing interest from around the world.

Now with 29 restaurants across Italy, Hong Kong, Japan, the UK and the US, along with a B Corporation certification – the first Italian food establishment to be granted one.

With a menu showcasing a selection of Prosciutto from Parma and Prague, along with bresaola from the valley of Valtellina, it’s hard to resist a taste of them all. But if there’s one you try during your visit, make it the Cacioburger.Scopri il vero Panino Italiano

name: Kartell
description: Kartell has always been a creative laboratory where designers are called upon to work with different materials on industrial products for different intended uses, indoors and outdoors

name: Pizzeria Gourmet Lievità
description: A Lievità Fidenza Village, vi offriamo un’esperienza culinaria completa che spazia dalla colazione alle insalate, dagli sfizi ai panuò, senza dimenticare il menù del giorno con proposte sempre nuove e diversificate.

name: Jil Sander
description: JIL SANDER, the high-end luxury brand, is the epitome of modernity and sophistication.

name: CROCS
description:
Crocs, Inc. is a world leader in casual footwear for men, women and children, combining comfort and style.

.

name: Brooks Brothers
description: Globally recognized for the American style, we embrace fashion, innovation and tradition since 1818.

name: Pandora
description: Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand. Discover a wide range of stunning pieces: choose from customizable collections or express your unique style with the finished jewelry lines Timeless and Pandora ESSENCE.

name: Ferragamo
description: Salvatore Ferragamo moved to America from Italy in 1914, eventually ending up in Hollywood where his repair and shoe-making business began to attract attention.

name: Puma
description: Go Wild with PUMA.

name: Antonio Marras
description: Fin dalla prima collezione, Antonio Marras si distingue per sperimentazione e capacità di fondere moda, arte, musica, danza, teatro e cinema.

name: Givenchy
description: Givenchy, founded in 1952 by Hubert de Givenchy, is an international luxury house known for its haute couture, ready-to-wear and accessories’ collections for men and women.

name: Outly
description: At the OUTLY LUXURY store, you will find a wide selection of sunglasses from the most prestigious brands, with discounts of up to 70%.

name: Acqua di Parma
description: The new Acqua di Parma boutique is opening at Fidenza Village. A place where you can immerse yourself in the radiance of fragrances and the Italian savoir-faire of the Maison.

name: My Style Bags
description:
My Style Bags celebrates the excellence of Made in Italy through accessories that combine quality, craftsmanship, and contemporary design. 
Each collection is born from a dedication to detail and the pursuit of carefully selected materials, while the customization available also in the village boutique makes every creation unique, transforming an accessory into an object of personal and timeless value.

name: Birkenstock
description:
Inspired by brutalist architecture, BIRKENSTOCK has established its own recognisable and aesthetic, which is framed by the function of the footbed. Every curve serves a purpose: reducing strain and enabling walking the way nature intended.

Crafted with precision.

name: Sun68
description:
Contemporary design, dynamic spirit and an effortless approach to everyday dressing.Born from the meeting of research, comfort and versatility, SUN68 brings an authentic and contemporary approach to style. Its collections reinterpret everyday essentials with distinctive details, refined colour palettes and a strong focus on quality.
From casual looks to relaxed occasions, the brand accompanies every moment of the day with understated elegance and unmistakable personality. The perfect balance between simplicity and character for those who appreciate effortless style with a distinctive edge.
